system.description:
Barbarians who learned the discipline of the shield wall and the weight of mail, and carry their fury into armour.

  • Armoured Fury: You are trained in heavy armour. Primeval Instincts and the wilderness abilities work in medium armour; only heavy armour switches them off.
  • Iron Rage: While you rage in medium or heavy armour, you gain +1 AC.
